founders-crossfunctional-teamwork-and-co.author: Naomi Carmen
founders-crossfunctional-teamwork-and-co.core: Posted in last 7 days Founders - Cross-Functional Teamwork & Company Culture During Growth Founders: I want to hear what you've learned about getting people to work well together. I'm working on a series of articles on leadership, company culture, and the challenges of building teams that actually work well as a company grows. If you’re a founder who's dealt with the messy, real-world side of teamwork- competing departmental priorities, communication breakdowns, cultural differences, workplace conflict, cliques, and getting employees to think beyond their individual roles- then I want to hear from you! I'd love your perspective on any of these questions: Cross-functional teamwork: Have you had two departments that both thought their priorities came first, even though they depended on each other? How did you get them aligned? Communication: Have you ever seen a misunderstanding arise from different communication styles or cultural expectations? How did you handle it? Trust and conflict: Have you had to rebuild trust between colleagues or teams after a disagreement or breakdown in communication? What helped? Company culture: Have you dealt with cliques, favoritism, or informal power dynamics that affected how people worked together? What did you change? Ownership: How do you get employees to see the bigger picture, take initiative, and contribute beyond their immediate job descriptions? Shared identity: If you have a remote, global, or multi-office team, what have you done to help people feel connected to the same organization? You don't need to answer every question. Pick whichever one connects to a real experience you've had. I'm especially interested in what happened, what you tried, what changed, and what you learned. Lessons from things that didn't work are welcome, too. A few sentences are enough to start. Comment below or email me at naomi @ consultgroupcom dot com. I’ll respond to the stories that my editor wants me to move forward with. #journorequest

La Stampa USA is its English-language edition for readers in the United States. It covers Italy, Italian culture, business, and current affairs, and it pays particular attention to the Italian-American community. The goal is not to translate Italian headlines, but to report stories that matter to both sides of the Atlantic. That two-way connection is what draws me to it. Italian Americans carry family histories, recipes, and memories of places many have never seen. Readers in Italy often know little about how their country’s food, wine, and businesses are seen across the ocean. I'm looking for someone in Germany who identifies as hikikomori and would be willing to share their experience with me. What I want to show: Not a stereotype, but what everyday life looks like, how the isolation feels from the inside, what makes it hard to leave the house, and what has or hasn't helped. If you're interested, or know someone who might be, you can reply here or send me a private message (my mail adress: [email redacted]). Please don't feel pressured to respond. Thank you for reading. people-who-turned-major-setbacks-into-co.core: Posted in last 7 days People Who Turned Major Setbacks Into Comebacks - Documentary Casting 🎬 FROM THE LITTLE GINGER KID WHO WAS TOLD HE’D NEVER AMOUNT TO ANYTHING… TO STANDING ALONGSIDE HOLLYWOOD’S OSCAR-NOMINATED FILMMAKERS. There are moments in life when I look around the room and think… HOW THE HELL DID I GET HERE? Last night in New Orleans was one of them. Spending time with Hollywood producers @richardgladstein Gladstein and @merylposter Poster, alongside award winning filmmaker Nicelle Herrington @ladynicelle at a special screening of Richard’s extraordinary film FINDING NEVERLAND, which received 7 Academy Award nominations, including BEST PICTURE. 🏆 Growing up surrounded by domestic violence, poverty and relentless bullying, I used to stare out of my classroom window and escape into my imagination. I dreamed of being James Bond. I dreamed of making films. I dreamed of becoming somebody the world told me I could never be. AND NOW I’M ACTUALLY MAKING FILMS THAT TELL THE STORIES OF PEOPLE JUST LIKE THAT LITTLE BOY. Being surrounded by extraordinary filmmakers reminds me that the most powerful stories often come from the most unexpected places. And that’s exactly why I created START OVER: COMEBACK TV. We’re developing a documentary series featuring real people who have survived extraordinary adversity and found the courage to rebuild their lives. I DON’T CARE WHERE YOU STARTED. I don’t care how many times you’ve failed. I don’t care who told you that you’d never amount to anything. I CARE ABOUT WHAT YOU DID NEXT. Because somewhere out there is another little boy or girl who desperately needs to see someone like YOU make it through. And your story could be the reason they never give up. 🎥 WE’RE NOW CASTING FOR THE COMEBACK TV DOCUMENTARY. If you’ve turned your greatest setback into a sensational comeback, I want to hear your story. 👇 COMMENT “COMEBACK” TO APPLY. THE WORLD MAY HAVE WRITTEN YOU OFF. NOW LET’S SHOW THEM WHAT HAPPENED NEXT. Marco ❤️ #MarcoRobinson #ComebackTV #StartOverMovement #FindingNeverland #RichardGladstein

uk-small-business-owners-impact-of-risin.core: Posted in last 7 days UK Small Business Owners - Impact of Rising Fuel & Heating Costs ITV News are coming to speak to me on Tuesday about the real impact rising fuel and heating costs are having on people and businesses. And I need your help. I don’t just want to give them my view from inside the fuel industry. I want to take real examples with me. So tell me honestly: How is it affecting your business? Are transport or delivery costs increasing? Is commuting to work becoming noticeably more expensive? Are you cutting back elsewhere at home because heating or fuel is costing more? Are you a farmer seeing machinery and operating costs rise? Are you a business owner having to absorb costs you can’t keep passing on? These are the stories that matter. We can all talk about rising costs, but when we’re given an opportunity to get those real experiences heard, we need to use it. So please comment below or message me privately if you’d rather not post publicly. I want ITV to hear more than just my voice — I want them to hear yours too. #FuelPrices #CostOfLiving #BusinessCosts #Farming #Transport #HeatingOil #EnergyCosts #UKBusiness #SmallBusiness #ITVNews ITV News

employees-at-european-orgs-switch-from-u.core: Posted in last 7 days Employees at European Orgs - Switch From US AI Provider to Mistral Has your employer moved from a US AI provider to Mistral - Business Insider Hi everyone — I’m Thibault, a tech reporter at Business Insider. I’m looking to speak with employees at European organizations that have moved from, or are considering moving from, a US AI provider like OpenAI or Anthropic, to Mistral. I’m especially interested in cases where data sovereignty, cybersecurity, procurement rules, customer contracts, or sector-specific requirements shaped that decision.
